absent: Channel teardown reference counting and buffer removal completion beyond close initiation.
Buffer storage allocation, reset semantics, mapping preparation, and early byte accounting.
Sub buffer start callback contract, veto handling, and wakeup work lifecycle.
Processor offline teardown and global channel negotiation details.
Resource insertion, containment, size, and generic walk primitive internals.
Custom alignment callback contract and architecture reservation exclusion policy.
Proc file creation parameters, permissions, and sequence position semantics beyond iteration.
Statistics flag encoding and diagnostic counter update paths for full conditions.
File open lifetime, private binding, and non seekable guarantees beyond reference hold.
Lock ordering between channel mutex, inode guard, and resource guard.

findings.text: Channel creation offers a single construction entry that validates geometry and callback presence and otherwise establishes a versioned per processor logging object with private context and optional base naming, returning an absent marker on any validation or resource failure.
Lifetime control provides idempotent teardown and forcing of current partial units to completed state, with null tolerance and distinct handling for shared global versus per processor configurations.

Production accounting exposes advancement of the current unit, external acknowledgement of consumed units with clamping to outstanding amount, and aggregated diagnostic counters selected by flag with range guard.
Per processor log files present standard open poll mapped access sequential read and release behaviour bound to a buffer reference held across the open lifetime with non seekable semantics.

A channel is either shared across processors with a single zero indexed buffer or replicated per processor, with creation and hotplug preparation reusing existing entries and cleaning up fully when any processor fails.

Each buffer cycles through filling and completed units tracked by monotonically increasing production and consumption totals plus per unit trailing unused space and a write position that uses an out of range sentinel to indicate a disabled or overrun unit requiring a switch before further use.

Read visibility respects wrap around overwrite policy where excess production advances the consumption baseline and skips trailing unused regions, exposing only committed bytes up to the current write frontier while preserving unfinished tail state.

A global channels mutex serializes channel list mutation and per processor buffer instantiation during creation teardown and processor preparation, while read side waiting uses deferred interrupt safe wakeup to avoid scheduler lock interaction.

A single read write guard protects the whole resource hierarchy with shared mode for traversal lookup display and intersection tests and exclusive mode for insertion release allocation and reallocation.
Sequential read holds the owning inode guard for the duration of availability evaluation and user copy, ensuring stable consumption state across the loop.
A small dispatcher record associates a channel buffer reference with its filesystem entry for handoff between creation and lookup paths.

Three global roots anchor the resource namespace with stable names and coverage, one for bus port space, one for full memory space, and one for soft reserved memory with a dedicated descriptor, each flagged for its address kind.
Resource display limits ancestor traversal to eight levels when computing indentation.

Resource management exposes conflict reporting insertion with busy indication, unconditional child release that detaches whole subtrees and resets ranges while retaining flags, and start keyed sibling lookup.

Space search honors caller supplied bounds and alignment with optional custom placement, clips candidate gaps to constraints, excludes early reservations, guards against arithmetic overflow and edge underflow, and reports busy when no suitable gap remains or when resizing an entry that still has descendants.
Hierarchy walk proceeds depth first favoring descendants before lateral peers and halts at a supplied subtree root, underpinning sequential display and generic walk helpers.

Two proc sequence views expose port and memory hierarchies with shared iteration callbacks, capability gated address disclosure, width adaptation for small roots, and fallback naming for unnamed entries.

Range walk helpers filter by address kind and descriptor to visit soft reservations, busy memory, and busy system memory converted to page frame intervals for callback processing, plus a boolean page residency test built atop the system memory walk and a guarded intersection test for soft reservations.
Auxiliary resource records are obtained zeroed and only returned when backed by reclaimable slab storage, deliberately leaking early boot allocations rather than complicating reuse.
Resource diagnostics use a module scoped message prefix derived from build identity.
Oversized advancement requests are rejected and tallied without state change, finalized buffers signal error to pollers, and creation guards against empty geometry and multiplicative overflow.
Display hides numeric extents from unprivileged viewers, child release emits debug traces per detached entry, and reallocation asserts absence of conflict after atomic detach and reinsertion.
